## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Scope and risk

- [ ] Existing behavior and related files were inspected.
- [ ] `main` remains unchanged until review and approval.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor or dependency was added.
- [ ] No secrets, fabricated metrics, fake testimonials, or unsupported claims were introduced.

## Privacy and legal review

- [ ] Reviewed third-party requests, fonts, analytics, session replay, cookies, storage, and logging.
- [ ] Reviewed forms, age handling, consent, and email rules if applicable.
- [ ] Reviewed payments and subscription disclosures if applicable.
- [ ] Reviewed uploads, user-content license, and asset/code licenses if applicable.
- [ ] Updated privacy/legal disclosures if actual product behavior changed.
- [ ] Marked non-applicable areas with a reason instead of assuming they pass.

## Design and accessibility

- [ ] No purple gradients, pill-shaped buttons, emoji UI icons, fake metrics, or fake reviews.
- [ ] No vague filler copy, unwanted AI branding, cursor animations, or excessive scroll effects.
- [ ] Responsive layout, keyboard navigation, visible focus, labels, contrast, and reduced motion reviewed.
- [ ] Favicon, Privacy Policy, and Terms and Conditions launch gates remain tracked.
